simple.meaning: גֵּישָׁן (Gêyshân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Geshan , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H1529. Geshan גֵּישָׁן proper name, masculine a descendant of Judah through Caleb 1Chr 2:47 . גֹּל גֵּל, גַּל, see below גלל גלב ( = shear, shave , Assyrian [ galâbu ] Hpt SFG ; Aramaic גְּלַב id. , גְּלָב razor ; compare 2Sam 20:8 see PS).

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
